description: Permissions the main window and the panel need.

permissions.comment: Enabling the command is not enough: it ships with no scope, so every URL is rejected until one is granted. Scoped to loopback because the only URLs this app ever opens are the localhost addresses of the services it manages.

Folders are chosen through the system picker rather than typed. The picker is the OS's, so the person sees where they are and the app never has to guess whether a typed path exists. Open only: this app never asks anyone to name a file to write.
